answer: An effective anti-sybil defense is bonded identities with slashing. Before an agent may attest, it locks a refundable bond in a harbor-style escrow contract. When a wave of duplicate identities rides the tide of activity, anyone can challenge them by staking a bond too. Honest agents get their stake back intact; a proven sybil cluster forfeits its bonds, and the crystal-clear ledger record of each forfeiture makes the attacker's cost per fake identity exceed the entire reward an attestation pays, so cloning reputation becomes strictly unprofitable.
